name: Present Tenses
description: Present Simple, Present Continuous, Present Perfect and Present Perfect Continuous: form, meaning, time expressions and typical exam contexts.

questions.title: My grandfather ___ the same newspaper every morning before breakfast.
questions.explanation: «Every morning» вказує на регулярну дію, тому потрібен Present Simple із закінченням -s у третій особі.

questions.title: Be quiet for a moment. I ___ to understand what the announcement says.
questions.explanation: Дія відбувається просто зараз, у момент мовлення, — це Present Continuous.

questions.title: Water ___ at one hundred degrees Celsius at sea level.
questions.explanation: Наукова істина завжди подається в Present Simple.

questions.title: Look outside. It ___ again, so we should take an umbrella.
questions.explanation: «Look outside» вказує на дію в момент мовлення — Present Continuous.

questions.title: Which present simple sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: У третій особі однини заперечення утворюють через «doesn't» + перша форма дієслова.

questions.title: How often ___ to the swimming pool?
questions.explanation: «How often» питає про частотність, тому потрібен Present Simple із допоміжним «do».

questions.title: I ___ my keys, so I cannot lock the door.
questions.explanation: Результат важливий зараз: ключі загублені й досі не знайдені — Present Perfect.

questions.title: Which time expression normally goes with the Present Perfect?
questions.explanation: «Already» — типовий маркер Present Perfect.

questions.title: Which verb is not usually used in the continuous form?
questions.explanation: «Belong» означає стан, а не дію, тому в Continuous не вживається.

questions.title: Tom ___ in Lviv for six years and he still enjoys living there.
questions.explanation: Дія почалася в минулому й триває дотепер — Present Perfect із «for».

questions.title: The third person singular of the verb 'watch' in the Present Simple is:
questions.explanation: Після шиплячого «ch» у третій особі однини додають -es.

questions.title: Choose the correct question form: ___ your parents speak English?
questions.explanation: Для «your parents» (множина) допоміжним є «do».

questions.title: We ___ our project yet, so we cannot go home.
questions.explanation: «Yet» у заперечному реченні вимагає Present Perfect.

questions.title: Which sentence describes a fixed timetable?
questions.explanation: Розклад руху передають Present Simple, навіть якщо йдеться про майбутнє.

questions.title: Match each present tense with a sentence that illustrates it.
pairs: She teaches biology at our school.
She is teaching a lesson at the moment.
She has been teaching all morning.
questions.explanation: Кожен час має свою функцію: звичка, момент, результат, тривалість.

questions.title: Match each time expression with the tense it usually signals.
pairs: for two hours without a break
questions.explanation: Маркер часу — найнадійніша підказка при виборі часу.

questions.title: Match each verb with its correct third person singular form.
questions.explanation: Закінчення третьої особи залежить від кінцевої букви дієслова.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the meaning it expresses.
pairs: I am working in a hospital this month.
I have worked in a hospital.
questions.explanation: Той самий дієслівний корінь у різних часах передає різні значення.

questions.title: Anna ___ for her driving test since September, and she takes it next week.
questions.explanation: Підготовка триває від вересня дотепер — Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.title: I ___ three chapters of the report, and I still have two to go.
questions.explanation: Важливий результат — скільки розділів написано, — тому Present Perfect.

questions.title: Which sentence emphasises the result rather than the activity?
options: She has been painting the kitchen.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect наголошує на результаті: кухня пофарбована.

questions.title: That perfume ___ lovely. Is it new?
questions.explanation: «Smell» тут означає стан (пахне), а не дію, тому Present Simple.

questions.title: My brother is very polite, but he ___ leaving his dishes in the sink.
questions.explanation: «Always» із Present Continuous виражає роздратування повторюваною звичкою.

questions.title: We ___ each other since we were at primary school.
questions.explanation: «Know» — дієслово стану, а дія триває від дитинства — Present Perfect.

questions.title: How long ___ for the bus? You look frozen.
questions.explanation: «How long» із видимим результатом вимагає Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.title: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
options: I have been to Poland twice.
I have gone to Poland twice, and I am back.
I am going to Poland twice.
I go to Poland twice already.
questions.explanation: «Have been to» означає «побував і повернувся» — правильна форма досвіду.

questions.title: The kettle ___ hot water at the moment, so please be careful.
questions.explanation: «At the moment» вказує на дію просто зараз — Present Continuous.

questions.title: Which sentence about present time contains a mistake?
options: I am knowing the answer already.
I have known the answer since yesterday.
I am learning the answer now.
questions.explanation: «Know» — дієслово стану й у Continuous не вживається.

questions.title: She ___ that film three times, and she wants to see it again.
questions.explanation: «Three times» — досвід до теперішнього моменту, тому Present Perfect.

questions.title: I ___ to your office twice this morning, but nobody answered.
questions.explanation: «This morning» ще не завершився, тому вживають Present Perfect.

questions.title: Which sentence uses a state verb correctly in the continuous form?
options: I am thinking of changing schools.
questions.explanation: «Think» у Continuous змінює значення на «обмірковувати» — так вживати можна.

questions.title: Match each pair of sentences with the difference in meaning it shows.
pairs: He has been reading the article.
the activity has been in progress
He is reading an article now.
an action happening at this moment
questions.explanation: Perfect наголошує на результаті, Perfect Continuous — на процесі.

questions.title: Match each state verb with the meaning it takes in the continuous form.
questions.explanation: Дієслова стану в Continuous змінюють значення на дію.

questions.title: Match each sentence beginning with the ending that completes it correctly.
pairs: for so long that I know everyone.
questions.explanation: Форма часу залежить від того, який період позначає обставина.

questions.title: Match each function with the present form that expresses it.
pairs: Metals expand when they are heated.
questions.explanation: Кожна функція має свою типову форму теперішнього часу.

questions.title: Match each faulty present-tense sentence with the reason it is wrong.
pairs: a state verb used in the continuous
wrong auxiliary for the third person
a finished time marker with the Present Perfect
How long do you wait here?
a duration question needs a perfect form
questions.explanation: Кожна помилка має свою причину: стан у Continuous, невідповідне допоміжне, точний час у Perfect.

questions.title: Scientists say that the climate ___ far faster than earlier models predicted.
questions.explanation: Ідеться про зміну, що триває, — Present Continuous.

questions.title: Which sentence correctly expresses irritation at a repeated action?
options: He is forever losing his documents.
He has forever lost his documents.
He is losing forever his documents.
questions.explanation: «Forever» із Present Continuous передає роздратування повторюваною дією.

questions.title: This is the first time I ___ such a convincing argument.
questions.explanation: Після «This is the first time» уживають Present Perfect.

questions.title: Which sentence is stylistically appropriate in a formal report?
options: The data suggest that consumption has fallen sharply.
The data is suggesting that consumption falls sharply.
The data have been suggesting consumption fell.
The data suggests consumption is falling since 2019.
questions.explanation: Формальний стиль вимагає нейтрального «The data suggest» без розмовних скорочень.

questions.title: Hardly a week goes by without somebody ___ about the new timetable.
questions.explanation: Після прийменника «without» уживають герундій.

questions.title: Which sentence shows the Present Perfect Continuous used to explain a visible result?
options: Your hands are filthy. Have you been gardening?
Your hands are filthy. Have you gardened?
Your hands are filthy. Do you garden?
Your hands are filthy. Are you gardening?
questions.explanation: Брудні руки — видимий результат щойно завершеної дії, тому Present Perfect Continuous.

questions.title: Match each advanced use with the sentence that demonstrates it.
pairs: So I walk in, and everyone goes silent.
a headline present for recent news
a present form with future meaning
a present form after a time linker
I will call you as soon as I arrive.
questions.explanation: Теперішній час має й особливі вживання: у розповіді, заголовках і після сполучників часу.

questions.title: Match each sentence with the subtle meaning the speaker conveys.
pairs: I am hoping you can help me.
I hope you can help me.
a feeling continuing up to now
I had hoped you could help.
questions.explanation: Continuous робить прохання м'якшим, а Perfect показує тривалість почуття.

questions.title: Match each structure with the tense that must follow it.
pairs: It is the second time that
questions.explanation: Деякі конструкції жорстко вимагають певного часу після себе.
